title: 🎓 Multiple Teaching Openings in Ste. Genevieve County, MO
text:
17 hours ago The local schools in Ste. Genevieve County are growing and looking for caring educators. If you love helping kids learn and want to work in a values-based setting, these openings might be a great fit.
Elementary Teacher Employer: Archdiocese of St. Louis
Location: Ste. Genevieve, MO
Type: Full-time
Join Ste. Genevieve Catholic Church as an Elementary Teacher and help shape young minds in a faith-filled, supportive environment. You’ll plan engaging lessons, guide students’ growth, and work closely with families and staff to build a strong learning community.
Preschool Teacher Employer: Archdiocese of St. Louis
Location: Ste. Genevieve, MO
Type: Full-time
This role focuses on early childhood education in a nurturing, play-based classroom. The Preschool Teacher will foster curiosity, creativity, and faith development while supporting each child’s social and emotional growth.
If you’re ready to make a difference in local classrooms, check out these openings and apply soon!
Please note: Job listings change quickly. Some positions listed here may have already been filled, and links may no longer be active. Contact the employer or visit the official website directly for the most up-to-date information.
